name: Synth kick
why: A kick built from nothing but a sine wave whose pitch falls very fast. Because it is a note, you can tune it to the track.

ingredients.name: A low sine
ingredients.adds: A bass note on every beat. Not a drum yet.

ingredients.name: Make it short
ingredients.adds: The note dies away instead of holding.

knobs.above: It booms into the next beat.

ingredients.name: Drop the pitch
ingredients.adds: Each hit starts high and falls to the note in a few hundredths of a second.
ingredients.listenFor: A click appears on the front. This fall is the kick.

knobs.label: drop time
knobs.above: You hear the pitch slide down.

ingredients.name: Drive
ingredients.adds: Squares off the sine so it is heard on small speakers.

pitfalls: A long decay sounds huge alone and leaves no room for the bass.
